g.text: Domain: Order-Service (Horizontal Scaling via Virtual Clusters & Regional Cell Isolation)
Both virtual clusters connect to the same keyspace; Cassandra physically separates partitions via composite keys
Tier 3 PK: ((us-central, us-central-cluster-1, order-service, date, win))
• Cluster-1 Retry-Nodes read (≤ W) & drop buckets via O(1) tombstones
Tier 3 PK: ((us-central, us-central-cluster-2, order-service, date, win))
• Cluster-2 Retry-Nodes read (≤ W) & drop buckets via O(1) tombstones
